name: HiCervix
description: An extensive hierarchical dataset and benchmark for cervical cytology classification that provides labeled cervical cell images across multiple hierarchical classes for evaluation of classification models.
evaluation_method: Accuracy and class-aware metrics such as macro F1 or hierarchical F1 to account for label hierarchy and class imbalance.
general_score_metric: macro F1 (classification) / hierarchical F1 when evaluating hierarchical labels
typical_sota_score: 70–90% (macro F1), depending on class granularity and preprocessing
reputation: A domain-specific medical imaging benchmark of interest to computational pathology researchers, with modest adoption in niche cervical cytology work.
notes: Medical dataset with class imbalance and domain-specific labeling—requires clinical validation for deployment; potential patient privacy considerations; non-LLM benchmark.
